query: Among the economies in the IMF World Economic Outlook database, take the one whose general government revenue in 2016 was between 25 and 27 percent of GDP, and whose general government gross debt at the end of 2016 was between 46 and 48 percent of GDP. How large was its government debt relative to its annual government revenue at the end of 2016?

text.text: Identifies the debt-to-revenue ratio (gross debt as a share of government revenue, i.e. debt/GDP divided by revenue/GDP) as the applicable debt-burden indicator (IMF 2013 Staff Guidance Note, MAC DSA template: debt-to-revenue ratio).
text.accept: full = end-of-year gross debt divided by the same year's revenue, in percent; partial = debt in years of revenue expressed correctly (e.g. 1.5 years = 150%); no = debt-to-GDP or interest-to-revenue.

text.text: Identifies the economy meeting the stated conditions as South Africa.
text.accept: must name the correct economy (ZAF) before the computation.

data.text: Uses general government revenue and grants (% GDP) and gross debt (% GDP) (WEO Oct 2025: GGR_NGDP, GGXWDG_NGDP).
data.accept: full = all inputs correctly sourced; partial = some inputs approximated; no = unrelated series.

computation.text: The value for South Africa in 2016 is about 180 % of revenue.
computation.accept: full = within +-5; partial = within +-10; no = otherwise.

grading.note: Verdicts exact. Convention for the gold (WEO Oct 2025, general government): interest paid = primary balance minus overall balance (% of GDP); revenue = general government revenue and grants (GGR_NGDP, % of GDP); interest-to-revenue = interest / revenue x 100; debt-to-revenue = end-of-year gross debt (% of GDP) / revenue (% of GDP) x 100, in percent of revenue.
grading.definitions: Convention for the gold (WEO Oct 2025, general government): interest paid = primary balance minus overall balance (% of GDP); revenue = general government revenue and grants (GGR_NGDP, % of GDP); interest-to-revenue = interest / revenue x 100; debt-to-revenue = end-of-year gross debt (% of GDP) / revenue (% of GDP) x 100, in percent of revenue.

provenance.method_text: IMF 2013 Staff Guidance Note (annex on stress tests: debt-burden indicators; MAC DSA template debt-to-revenue)

published_value_note: No corpus report states this country-year value for the identity on the frozen vintage; formula printed in the method document (gate a), inputs public (b), gold by script (c).
